content.text:
DVDs can now be renewed twice. I changed `maxRenewals` for `dvd` from 1 to 2 in `lib/config/defaults.js`, and the renewal check in `lib/circulation/renewals.js` reads that value, so no other code changed. Books keep 2 renewals, magazines and laptops keep 0.

I updated the existing DVD test in `test/renewals.test.js`, since it asserted the old limit of one. It now expects two renewals to succeed and the third to be refused with `renewal-limit`. All 59 tests pass.

I haven't committed anything.
